provenance.description: Every tensor of the released Qwen3.8-27B as converted for Simply, name -> shape. Ground truth for utils/ckpt_format_test.py: it is read off the checkpoint, not derived from this package.
provenance.generator: fileutil cp $CKPT/1/state/_METADATA /tmp/_METADATA; then, per Orbax leaf, `name = entry['key_metadata'][0]['key']` and `shape = entry['value_metadata']['write_shape']` over `json.load(open('/tmp/_METADATA'))['tree_metadata'].values()`, sorted by name. No weights are read: the file lists shapes only.
